overview: MQstore is a luxury watch brand website with a bold black and gold aesthetic. It features four pages — Home, Shop, About, and Contact — with a dedicated men's watches collection, smooth animations, and a premium modern design.
features: Hero section with luxury typography and CTA
Men's watch collection with product cards and filters
Watch detail pages with image gallery and specs
Brand story and heritage on About page
Black and gold luxury design with smooth animations
Fully responsive across mobile and desktop
